title: A client form's title, description and date can be removed
description: These used to be fixed on every client form. They are now default fields in the builder's left pane: rename them, remove them, or add them back. Name and email are still always asked.
items: A form without a title names each request after the form and its reference
The date is now the client's ideal finish date: optional, and never the due date
pending: Needs the P16 database updates applied before it works.
